# lamejs 1.2.1

Unmodified browser bundles from https://www.npmjs.com/package/lamejs/v/1.2.1
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
Upstream: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
Copyright (c) 2014 Alexander Sidorov; LGPL-3.0, see LICENSE, COPYING.LESSER and COPYING.

The application loads lame.min.js in a Worker. The corresponding unminified source
is included as lame.all.js; you may replace the bundle with a modified compatible
version. No CDN requests are made at runtime.
